title: Scan data for quick structural summaries and checks
text: basic example shows solve common problem:
code: library(datascan) head(CO2) #>   Plant   Type  Treatment conc uptake #> 1   Qn1 Quebec nonchilled   95   16.0 #> 2   Qn1 Quebec nonchilled  175   30.4 #> 3   Qn1 Quebec nonchilled  250   34.8 #> 4   Qn1 Quebec nonchilled  350   37.2 #> 5   Qn1 Quebec nonchilled  500   35.3 #> 6   Qn1 Quebec nonchilled  675   39.2 cols_identify_all(CO2) #> → No columns with all unique values. #> → No bijective columns. #> → No constant columns. #> → No identified columns with missing proportion. #>  #> ── Checking if all values are unique in a column ─────────────────────────────── #> [1] NA #>  #> ── Checking if any two columns are bijective ─────────────────────────────────── #> list() #>  #> ── Checking if any column is all constant ────────────────────────────────────── #> [1] NA #>  #> ── Checking if columns with preset cut-off in missing values ─────────────────── #> [1] NA cols_nested(CO2) #> [[1]] #> [1] "Plant" "Type"  #>  #> [[2]] #> [1] "Plant"     "Treatment" concurrence_matrix(CO2, Plant, Type) #> • Diagonal shows the total number of levels for Plant at the corresponding #>   level for Type #> • Off-diagonal shows the number of common levels for Plant between the two #>   levels for Type #>               #>               Quebec Mississippi #>   Quebec           6           0 #>   Mississippi      0           6 #>    #> ℹ Concurrence matrix: 2 × 2 Type.

title: A field experiment assessing the roles of drought, herbivory, and local climate for white clovers — white_clover
text: Garden: Location site plants grown (e.g., Ontario). WholePlotID: Identifier whole plot main experimental block. SplitPlotID: Identifier smaller sub-division within whole plot. PlantID: Unique identifier plant. Cyanotype: Plant type based cyanogenesis (whether plant produces cyanogenic compounds). Values like AcLi, Acli, etc., indicate different cyanotype genotypes. Cyanogenesis: Whether plant cyanogenic (produces cyanide compounds) — e.g., Cyanogenic Acyanogenic. Ac_ac Li_li: Specific alleles/genetic markers related cyanogenesis genes. Different capitalization indicates allele variants. Precipitation: Experimental treatment water — e.g., reduced controlled precipitation. Herbivores: Herbivory pressure treatment — e.g., reduced Control (normal) herbivore presence. Survived21: Binary (0/1) indicating whether plant survived year 21. Flowered21: Binary (0/1) indicating whether plant flowered year 21. Seeded21: Binary (0/1) indicating whether plant produced seeds year 21. FlowerHeadNumber21: Number flower heads produced plant year 21. SeedSetMass21: Mass (likely grams mg) seeds set year 21. MaxArea21: Maximum area (likely leaf plant canopy area) measured year 21. GrowthRate21: Growth rate plant year 21 (units unclear, possibly relative absolute growth). Herbivory21: Measure herbivore damage intensity plant year 21. SurvivedWinter: Binary (0/1) indicating whether plant survived winter period. Survived22: Binary (0/1) indicating survival year 22. Flowered22: Binary (0/1) indicating flowering status year 22. Seeded22: Binary (0/1) indicating seed production year 22. FlowerHeadNumber22: Number flower heads produced year 22. SeedSetMass22: Mass seeds set year 22. MaxArea22: Maximum area measured year 22. GrowthRate22: Growth rate year 22. Herbivory22: Herbivore damage measure year 22.
